name: Farm Fresh Berhad
overview: 2026年，Farm Fresh Berhad 的公告主要涉及股本发行、股票分割、股息派发及公司治理事项，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。最新季度营收同比增长17.6%，净利润同比下降18.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, Farm Fresh Berhad's announcements mainly involved share issuance, share subdivision, dividend payment, and corporate governance matters, with no disclosure of specific business segment expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins. Latest quarterly revenue grew 17.6% year-on-year, while net profit declined 18.2%.
